name: Checkbox & Radio
blurb: Checkbox, radio group, and switch, drawn from the native controls.
mechanism: Native input plus accent-color for the tint. The switch is the same checkbox with its track and knob drawn by peer-checked classes - no second control.
caveats: The switch reads as a checkbox to assistive tech. If it toggles something immediately, say so in the label rather than relying on the shape.
accent-color styles the control but not its focus ring, which stays the platform's.
